title: More than 3,300 high chairs from Costway recalled over safety hazard, Consumer Product Safety Commission says: Here's what to know - ABC7 Bay Area
text:
More than 3,300 high chairs from Costway recalled over safety hazard, Consumer Product Safety Commission says: Here's what to know - ABC7 San Francisco 
 24/7 Live San Francisco East Bay South Bay Peninsula North Bay 7 On Your Side 
 More than 3,300 high chairs from Costway recalled over safety hazard: CPSC 
 A warning for parents and guardians. The Consumer Product Safety Commission is recalling more than 3,300 convertible high chairs from Costway. By Stephanie Sierra , Justin Mendoza Monday, November 16, 2026 2:35AM Share Follow ABC7 on Google SAN FRANCISCO (KGO) -- A warning for parents and guardians. The Consumer Product Safety Commission is recalling more than 3,300 convertible high chairs from Costway.
 The high chairs, which could convert into a table or chair set, do not contain a restraint system.
 The child could slip through the opening, get trapped or fall, risking serious injury or even death.
 The recalled high chairs were sold at Target, Walmart, and Costway.com between May 2023 through July 2026.
 If you have this brand at home, the agency and company said to get rid of it, or you can contact Costway for a free replacement.
 You'll be asked to provide a receipt or photo of the item.
 Then, you'll get a prepaid label to send it back, and get a new high chair, free of charge.
 Fortunately, no injuries have been reported.
